confidence_notes: Food anchors are rough bounded estimates from aggregated India cost-of-living sources and a few undated Pushkar listings, not verified current menus. Beer, cocktail and wine are weakest: Pushkar bans alcohol and it is generally not served openly, so these values are hypothetical and based on a local price relationship to beer plus national draft-beer ranges. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Pushkar's tourist market and were not checked against live listings. The FX rate is the RBA 4.00 pm observation for 18 November 2026; the 19 November figure was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Rajasthan tourist towns of similar scale (for example Jodhpur and Udaipur, scaled down) with a vegetarian-focused, backpacker-oriented food scene. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors use the national India draft-beer price range as the base, then apply a scarcity uplift for Pushkar's alcohol restrictions. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for the same tourist segment.
